```python
def transform(grid):
    # 1. Identify background color (usually grid[0][0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    
    # 2. Find bounding box of non-background pixels (the frame)
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    r_min, r_max = rows, -1
    c_min, c_max = cols, -1
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                if r < r_min: r_min = r
                if r > r_max: r_max = r
                if c < c_min: c_min = c
                if c > c_max: c_max = c
    
    if r_max < r_min: return grid  # No distinct frame found
    
    # 3. Define Interior Corners
    # (r_min + 1, c_min + 1) to (r_max - 1, c_max - 1)
    int_tl_r, int_tr_r = r_min + 1, r_min + 1
    int_bl_r, int_br_r = r_max - 1, r_max - 1
    int_tl_c = c_min + 1
    int_bl_c = c_min + 1
    int_tr_c = c_max - 1
    
    val_tl = grid[int_tl_r][int_tl_c]
    val_tr = grid[int_tr_r][int_tr_c]
    val_bl = grid[int_bl_r][int_bl_c]
    val_br = grid[int_br_r][int_br_c]
    
    # 4. Define Exterior Corners
    # Top (r_min - 1), Bot (r_max + 1)
    # Left (c_min - 1), Right (c_max + 1)
    ext_tl_r, ext_tr_r = r_min - 1, r_min - 1
    ext_bl_r, ext_br_r = r_max + 1, r_max + 1
    ext_tl_c = c_min - 1
    ext_bl_c = c_min - 1
    ext_tr_c = c_max + 1
    ext_br_c = c_max + 1
    
    # 5. Apply Mapping (Int BR -> Ext TL, Int TR -> Ext BL, etc.)
    # Int TL -> Ext BR
    grid[ext_br_r][ext_br_c] = val_tl
    
    # Int TR -> Ext BL
    grid[ext_bl_r][ext_bl_c] = val_tr
    
    # Int BL -> Ext TR
    grid[ext_tr_r][ext_tr_c] = val_bl
    
    # Int BR -> Ext TL
    grid[ext_tl_r][ext_tl_c] = val_br
    
    # 6. Clear Interior Corners to Background
    grid[int_tl_r][int_tl_c] = bg
    grid[int_tr_r][int_tr_c] = bg
    grid[int_bl_r][int_bl_c] = bg
    grid[int_br_r][int_br_c] = bg
    
    return grid
```
